title: Περὶ τοῦ βίου Μωυσέως — Philo, On the Life of Moses I–II (RU «О жизни Моисея»)
author: Philo of Alexandria
edition: L. Cohn, Philonis Alexandrini opera IV (1902), public domain: https://archive.org/details/philonisalexandr0004leop.
ru_evidence: Absent from the ruwiki list of about 14 Russian Philo translations and from CyberLeninka and Yearbook listings (Matusova; Afonasin's De aeternitate, 2025–26). Not verified in the RSL catalogue.
en_evidence: F. H. Colson, Philo VI (Loeb 1935), per the ruwiki Loeb list. Also Yonge's 19th-c. translation.
other_translations: French (Œuvres de Philon) and German (Die Werke Philos) series exist; not individually verified here.
value: Moses portrayed as philosopher-king, lawgiver, priest and prophet. Key for Jewish-Greek political thought, Hellenistic ideal-ruler literature (cf. the Alexander tradition) and early Christian Moses typology.
ai_feasibility: High. Fluent Atticizing prose with rich parallels; Loeb for cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Book I (Moses' birth to Balaam), about 18k words; mini-pilot Mos. II 1–65.
